records.context: **A softmax is not a probability.** Everything here is called an uncertainty *score*, never a confidence. Modern networks are badly calibrated — typically over-confident, and more so the deeper they are (Guo et al., 2017) — so a 0.87 from the head is not "87 % sure". The scores are used for one thing only: putting extracted image regions in an order. Nothing in this module reports a calibrated probability, and neither should anything built on it. See :data:`CALIBRATION_NOTE`.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **A softmax is not a probability.** Everything here is called an uncertainty *score*, never a confidence. Modern networks are badly calibrated — typically over-confident, and more so the deeper they are (Guo et al., 2017) — so a 0.87 from the head is not "87 % sure". The scores are used for one thing only: putting crops in an order. Nothing in this module reports a calibrated probability, and neither should anything built on it. See :data:`CALIBRATION_NOTE`.
records.translation: **Softmax er ekki líkindi.** Allt hér er kallað óvissu*einkunn*, aldrei vissa. Nútímanet eru illa kvörðuð — yfirleitt of viss, og því meira sem þau eru dýpri (Guo et al., 2017) — svo 0.87 frá hausnum merkir ekki "87 % sure". Einkunnirnar eru aðeins notaðar til eins: að raða myndskurðum. Ekkert í þessari einingu tilkynnir kvörðuð líkindi, og það ætti ekkert sem byggt er á henni heldur að gera. Sjá :data:`CALIBRATION_NOTE`.

records.context: **The two head shapes are handled separately.** The machine-learning classification model head emits either a single logit (binary; needs a sigmoid) or C logits (multiclass; needs a softmax) — see :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.apply_model_to_tar`. Pushing a single-logit column through a softmax yields a column of 1.0 and destroys the ordering; pushing C logits through a sigmoid can *invert* it. Both are silent failures that produce a confident-looking work list full of nonsense, so :func:`probabilities_from_logits` branches on the shape and the tests pin both directions.
records.label: spacr.active_learning#7
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **The two head shapes are handled separately.** The classifier head emits either a single logit (binary; needs a sigmoid) or C logits (multiclass; needs a softmax) — see :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.apply_model_to_tar`. Pushing a single-logit column through a softmax yields a column of 1.0 and destroys the ordering; pushing C logits through a sigmoid can *invert* it. Both are silent failures that produce a confident-looking queue full of nonsense, so :func:`probabilities_from_logits` branches on the shape and the tests pin both directions.
records.translation: **Lögunum haussins tveimur er haldið aðskildum.** Flokkunarhausinn gefur út annaðhvort eitt logit (tvíkosta; þarf sigmoid) eða C logit (fjölflokka; þarf softmax) — sjá :func:`spacr.deep_spacr.apply_model_to_tar`. Ef eins logits dálki er ýtt í gegnum softmax fæst dálkur af 1.0 og röðunin eyðileggst; ef C logitum er ýtt í gegnum sigmoid getur hún *snúist við*. Hvort tveggja eru hljóðlátar villur sem framleiða biðröð sem lítur út fyrir að vera örugg en er full af vitleysu, svo :func:`probabilities_from_logits` greinist eftir lögun og prófanirnar festa báðar áttir.

records.context: Why this rule and not another:
records.label: spacr.active_learning.should_stop#2
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Why this rule and not another:
records.translation: Hvers vegna þessi regla en ekki önnur:

records.context: **Labels, not rounds, are the unit of cost.** A round is whatever size the annotator felt like; "no improvement for 3 rounds" says nothing when the rounds were 5, 300 and 8 labels. The thing being spent is human attention, one extracted image region at a time, so the window is measured in extracted image regions.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.should_stop#3
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Labels, not rounds, are the unit of cost.** A round is whatever size the annotator felt like; "no improvement for 3 rounds" says nothing when the rounds were 5, 300 and 8 labels. The thing being spent is human attention, one crop at a time, so the window is measured in crops.
records.translation: **Merki, ekki umferðir, eru kostnaðareiningin.** Umferð er af hvaða stærð sem skýrandanum sýndist; "no improvement for 3 rounds" segir ekkert þegar umferðirnar voru 5, 300 og 8 merki. Það sem er eytt er athygli manneskju, einn myndskurður í einu, svo glugginn er mældur í myndskurðum.

records.context: **It refuses to answer early.** Below ``label_window`` labels since the first recorded round there is no window to measure, and a rule that fired anyway would tell people to stop after their first twelve labels.
records.label: spacr.active_learning.should_stop#5
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **It refuses to answer early.** Below ``label_window`` labels since the first recorded round there is no window to measure, and a rule that fired anyway would tell people to stop after their first twelve labels.

records.source: This module converts vendor image files into a layout spaCR can read. It is **decoupled from the mask pipeline**: nothing here imports torch, cellpose or :mod:`spacr.core`, so it can be run, tested and previewed on a laptop with no GPU and no segmentation settings in sight.
records.translation: Þessi eining breytir myndskrám framleiðenda í uppsetningu sem spaCR getur lesið. Hún er **aftengd grímuvinnslukeðjunni**: ekkert hér flytur inn torch, cellpose eða :mod:`spacr.core`, svo hægt er að keyra hana, prófa og forskoða á fartölvu án GPU og án nokkurra bútunarstillinga.

records.context: **Z that is not silently flattened.** ``convert_to_yokogawa`` max-projects unconditionally in three of its four branches (ND2, LIF, and both the 3-D and 4-D TIFF cases), and says so nowhere in its output. Here the default is :data:`Z_KEEP` — every image layer is written with its own ``Z##`` — and choosing to project is an explicit ``z_handling='max'``, announced in the plan and recorded per row in the map file.
records.label: spacr.convert#10
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Z that is not silently flattened.** ``convert_to_yokogawa`` max-projects unconditionally in three of its four branches (ND2, LIF, and both the 3-D and 4-D TIFF cases), and says so nowhere in its output. Here the default is :data:`Z_KEEP` — every plane is written with its own ``Z##`` — and choosing to project is an explicit ``z_handling='max'``, announced in the plan and recorded per row in the map file.
records.translation: **Z sem er ekki fletjað hljóðlega.** ``convert_to_yokogawa`` gerir hámarksvörpun skilyrðislaust í þremur af fjórum greinum sínum (ND2, LIF, og bæði 3-D og 4-D TIFF-tilvikin), og segir það hvergi í úttaki sínu. Hér er sjálfgefið :data:`Z_KEEP` — hvert plan er skrifað með eigin ``Z##`` — og val um vörpun er skýrt ``z_handling='max'``, tilkynnt í áætluninni og skráð fyrir hverja línu í vörpunarskránni.

records.context: **No new required dependencies.** ``nd2reader`` / ``czifile`` / ``readlif`` are probed with :func:`importlib.util.find_spec`; when one is missing the affected files are reported as skipped with the package name and the ``pip install`` line, never as an ImportError traceback.

records.source: **No new required dependencies.** ``nd2reader`` / ``czifile`` / ``readlif`` are probed with :func:`importlib.util.find_spec`; when one is missing the affected files are reported as skipped with the package name and the ``pip install`` line, never as an ImportError traceback.
records.translation: **Engin ný nauðsynleg ósjálfstæði.** Kannað er hvort ``nd2reader`` / ``czifile`` / ``readlif`` séu til með :func:`importlib.util.find_spec`; þegar eitthvert þeirra vantar eru skrárnar sem það varðar tilkynntar sem sleppt ásamt heiti pakkans og ``pip install``-línunni, aldrei sem ImportError-rakning.

records.context: **Never overwrite.** Two sources landing on one target name is a *plan-time error* naming both, not a last-writer-wins at convert time. An output that already exists on disk is skipped and counted, so a repeat execution is a no-op rather than a silent rewrite.
records.label: spacr.convert#13
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: **Never overwrite.** Two sources landing on one target name is a *plan-time error* naming both, not a last-writer-wins at convert time. An output that already exists on disk is skipped and counted, so a re-run is a no-op rather than a silent rewrite.
records.translation: **Aldrei skrifað yfir.** Tveir upprunar sem lenda á sama markheiti eru *villa við áætlun* sem nefnir báða, ekki að síðasti ritari vinni við umbreytingu. Úttak sem þegar er til á diskinum er sleppt og talið, svo endurkeyrsla gerir ekkert í stað þess að endurskrifa hljóðlega.

records.context: **Atomic writes.** Every TIFF is written to a temp file in the destination and :func:`os.replace`\ d into place, so an interrupted run leaves no half-written file that the next run mistakes for done.

records.translation: **Forskoðun.** Það skrifar á meðan það gengur í gegn. Það er enginn tímapunktur þar sem þú getur litið á "``run1/wt/fov01_C1.tif`` → ``plate1_A01_…C01.tif``" og sagt nei. :func:`plan` framleiðir þá töflu og skrifar ekkert.

records.context: **A map you can read back.** It writes a ``rename_log.csv`` whose columns differ per input format (the LIF and TIFF branches record two columns; the ND2 branch records seven; the CZI branch records nine), and nothing in spaCR ever reads it. :func:`write_map` emits one fixed schema and :func:`read_map` / :func:`populate_db_from_map` read it back, so after a run the original filename for any measurement is one SQL join away.

records.source: An imaging screen is mostly intermediates. ``stack/`` is the raw files re-shaped, ``merged/`` is ``stack/`` with the masks concatenated on, ``data/`` is one PNG per object, and a plate that arrives as 40 GB of TIFFs leaves 400 GB behind. This module reports where the space in a project is used, and clears derived data without touching the raw microscope images, which cannot be regenerated.
records.translation: Myndgreiningarskimun er að mestu milliniðurstöður. ``stack/`` eru hráu skrárnar í nýrri lögun, ``merged/`` er ``stack/`` með grímunum skeyttum við, ``data/`` er ein PNG á hvern hlut, og plata sem berst sem 40 GB af TIFF-skrám skilur eftir sig 400 GB. Þessi eining tilkynnir hvar plássið í verkefni er notað og hreinsar afleidd gögn án þess að snerta hráu smásjármyndirnar, sem ekki er hægt að endurgera.

records.context: 1. the registry knows it — anything unregistered is never a candidate; 2. its kind is not an **original** (:data:`ORIGINAL_KINDS`): nothing in :mod:`spacr.ports` declares that it produces raw images or sequencing reads, so nothing can make them again; 3. a declared **producing module** exists for its kind, and the module the registry recorded is one of them; 4. that module's **inputs are complete** — every recorded input artifact is still registered and still on disk, and :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` says the module could execute in this project right now; 5. it was written by a processing session that **finished** (``status == "complete"``); 6. what is on disk still **fingerprints to what was registered**, so a folder somebody has since dropped a file into is not prunable; 7. it lives **inside the project**, reached without following a symlink; 8. **every** artifact sharing its path passes all of the above — three kinds live in ``measurements.db``, and deleting the file for one of them destroys the other two; 9. no other registered artifact sits inside it or around it, because the bytes belong to the innermost one and a plan must not under-report what it deletes.

records.translation: 1. afurðaskráin þekkir hana — ekkert óskráð er nokkurn tíma kandídat; 2. tegund hennar er ekki **frumgögn** (:data:`ORIGINAL_KINDS`): ekkert í :mod:`spacr.ports` lýsir því yfir að það framleiði hráar myndir eða raðgreiningarlestra, svo ekkert getur búið þau til aftur; 3. yfirlýst **framleiðslueining** er til fyrir tegund hennar, og einingin sem afurðaskráin skráði er ein þeirra; 4. **inntök þeirrar einingar eru fullkomin** — hver skráð inntaksafurð er enn skráð og enn á diskinum, og :func:`spacr.ports.check_ready` segir að einingin gæti keyrt í þessu verkefni núna; 5. hún var skrifuð af keyrslu sem **lauk** (``status == "complete"``); 6. það sem er á diskinum **hefur enn sama fingrafar og það sem var skráð**, svo mappa sem einhver hefur síðan sett skrá í er ekki grisjanleg; 7. hún býr **innan verkefnisins**, náð án þess að fylgja tákntengli; 8. **hver** afurð sem deilir slóð hennar stenst allt ofangreint — þrjár tegundir búa í ``measurements.db``, og ef skránni er eytt fyrir eina þeirra eyðileggjast hinar tvær; 9. engin önnur skráð afurð situr inni í henni eða umhverfis hana, því bætin tilheyra þeirri innstu og áætlun má ekki vanmeta það sem hún eyðir.

records.source: So the index is computed over the **union foreground** — the pixels at least one model assigned to an object — with pixels the *other* model left unassigned treated as unclustered singletons rather than as one big background cluster. With background as a single cluster, a model that misses an entire object still scores 1.0, because "one object plus a background blob" and "one object plus a background blob" are the same partition. As singletons, missing half the objects scores 0.50.
records.translation: Því er vísirinn reiknaður yfir **sameinaðan forgrunn** — pixlana sem að minnsta kosti annað líkanið úthlutaði hlut — þar sem pixlar sem *hitt* líkanið úthlutaði ekki eru meðhöndlaðir sem óklasaðir stakir þættir frekar en sem einn stór bakgrunnsklasi. Sem stakir þættir fær það 0.50 ef það missir af helmingi hlutanna.

records.source: ARI is a *pixel-pair* index, so it is sensitive to boundaries and it is degenerate when a field holds one object (a single cluster has no pair structure to agree about). It is reported next to the object-level numbers for that reason, never alone.

records.context: ``iou_matched_fraction`` and ``mean_matched_iou`` — from an **optimal** assignment, not a greedy one. Matching objects between two segmentations is a bipartite assignment problem; picking each object's best partner double-assigns, and picking greedily in descending IoU can leave a pair stranded that an optimal assignment would have kept. records.context: A comparison that differs only in an argument the model never sees reports "no difference" and wastes the processing session. On the installed Cellpose 4, these are accepted and then dropped (see :data:`IGNORED_ARGUMENTS`): ``model_type``, ``diam_mean`` and ``nchan`` at construction, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` at ``eval``, plus spaCR's own ``restore_type``. Every pre-SAM model name resolves to ``cpsam`` too, so "cyto3 versus nuclei" is one model against itself.
records.label: spacr.model_compare#28
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: A comparison that differs only in an argument the model never sees reports "no difference" and wastes the run. On the installed Cellpose 4, these are accepted and then dropped (see :data:`IGNORED_ARGUMENTS`): ``model_type``, ``diam_mean`` and ``nchan`` at construction, ``channels`` and ``rescale`` at ``eval``, plus spaCR's own ``restore_type``. Every pre-SAM model name resolves to ``cpsam`` too, so "cyto3 versus nuclei" is one model against itself.
records.translation: Samanburður sem er aðeins ólíkur í færibreytu sem líkanið sér aldrei tilkynnir "no difference" og sóar keyrslunni. Í uppsettu Cellpose 4 er tekið við eftirfarandi og þeim síðan sleppt (sjá :data:`IGNORED_ARGUMENTS`): ``model_type``, ``diam_mean`` og ``nchan`` við smíði, ``channels`` og ``rescale`` við ``eval``, auk eigin ``restore_type`` spaCR. Hvert líkanaheiti frá því fyrir SAM leysist líka í ``cpsam``, svo "cyto3 versus nuclei" er eitt líkan borið saman við sjálft sig.

records.source: The index is taken over the pixels at least one mask assigned to an object. Pixels neither mask claimed are dropped entirely: they are the agreement that would otherwise be the whole answer.
records.translation: Vísirinn er reiknaður yfir pixlana sem að minnsta kosti önnur gríman úthlutaði hlut. Pixlum sem hvorug gríman gerði tilkall til er sleppt alveg: þeir eru samkomulagið sem annars væri allt svarið.

records.context: **2. Units are translated through an explicit table, and an unknown one is refused.** :data:`NGFF_UNIT_TO_SPACR` is the mapping, written out. A unit that is not in it throws :class:`OmeZarrError`. It would be one line to default to ``"px"`` instead, and that one line is how a 0.65 µm pixel becomes a 0.65 px pixel and every downstream area comes out wrong by a factor of 10^6 — in a column named ``cell_area`` that still looks plausible. The error distinguishes the two cases that need different fixes: a unit NGFF does not define (the file is wrong), and a legal NGFF unit spaCR has no short token for (convert it, e.g. to ``micrometer``).

records.source: **2. Units are translated through an explicit table, and an unknown one is refused.** :data:`NGFF_UNIT_TO_SPACR` is the mapping, written out. A unit that is not in it raises :class:`OmeZarrError`. It would be one line to default to ``"px"`` instead, and that one line is how a 0.65 µm pixel becomes a 0.65 px pixel and every downstream area comes out wrong by a factor of 10^6 — in a column named ``cell_area`` that still looks plausible. The error distinguishes the two cases that need different fixes: a unit NGFF does not define (the file is wrong), and a legal NGFF unit spaCR has no short token for (convert it, e.g. to ``micrometer``).
records.translation: **2. Einingar eru þýddar í gegnum skýra töflu, og óþekktri einingu er hafnað.** :data:`NGFF_UNIT_TO_SPACR` er vörpunin, skrifuð út. Eining sem er ekki í henni kastar :class:`OmeZarrError`. Það væri ein lína að nota ``"px"`` sjálfgefið í staðinn, og sú eina lína er hvernig 0.65 µm pixill verður 0.65 px pixill og hvert flatarmál síðar í ferlinu verður rangt um þáttinn 10^6 — í dálki sem heitir ``cell_area`` og lítur enn trúverðuglega út. Villan greinir á milli tilvikanna tveggja sem þarfnast ólíkra lagfæringa: eining sem NGFF skilgreinir ekki (skráin er röng), og lögleg NGFF-eining sem spaCR hefur ekkert stutt tákn fyrir (umbreytið henni, t.d. í ``micrometer``).

records.context: **3. A missing unit means pixels, and is reported.** An NGFF file whose space axes carry no ``unit`` is legal and common — it is what every tool that never knew the pixel size writes. That reads back as ``units="px"`` with :attr:`OmeZarrImage.units_declared` ``False`` and a :meth:`OmeZarrImage.describe` line that says the file declared none. It is never silently upgraded to µm, and ``"px"`` is never written out as a unit string, because NGFF has no pixel unit: writing a px spacing emits axes with no ``unit``, which is the same convention read back.

That reads back as ``units="px"`` with :attr:`OmeZarrImage.units_declared` ``False`` and a :meth:`OmeZarrImage.describe` line that says the file declared none. It is never silently upgraded to µm, and ``"px"`` is never written out as a unit string, because NGFF has no pixel unit: writing a px spacing emits axes with no ``unit``, which is the same convention read back.
records.translation: **3. Eining sem vantar merkir pixla, og það er tilkynnt.** NGFF-skrá þar sem rúmásarnir bera ekkert ``unit`` er lögleg og algeng — það er það sem hvert verkfæri sem aldrei vissi pixlastærðina skrifar. Það lest til baka sem ``units="px"`` með :attr:`OmeZarrImage.units_declared` ``False`` og línu í :meth:`OmeZarrImage.describe` sem segir að skráin hafi enga lýst. Það er aldrei hljóðlega uppfært í µm, og ``"px"`` er aldrei skrifað út sem einingastrengur, því NGFF hefur enga pixlaeiningu: skrift px-bils gefur út ása án ``unit``, sem er sama venja lesin til baka.

records.context: Every public sampler takes exactly one of ``seed=`` or ``rng=`` and refuses to execute with neither. The global numpy random state is never touched. A statistical detection sensitivity analysis is a number somebody defends in a grant review or a methods section, and a result drawn from OS entropy cannot be executed again bit-for-bit, so omitting both is treated as a configuration error.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate#12
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: Every public sampler takes exactly one of ``seed=`` or ``rng=`` and refuses to run with neither. The global numpy random state is never touched. A power analysis is a number somebody defends in a grant review or a methods section, and a result drawn from OS entropy cannot be re-run bit-for-bit, so omitting both is treated as a configuration error.
records.translation: Hver opinber úrtakari tekur nákvæmlega annað af ``seed=`` eða ``rng=`` og neitar að keyra án hvorugs. Víðværri slembistöðu numpy er aldrei snert. Aflgreining er tala sem einhver ver í mati á styrkumsókn eða í aðferðakafla, og niðurstöðu sem dregin er úr óreiðu OS er ekki hægt að endurkeyra bita fyrir bita, svo að sleppa hvoru tveggja er meðhöndlað sem stillingavilla.

records.context: Mis-assignment gives a gene phantom reads in microplate sample positions it never entered, so the covariate the model regresses positive counts on is a shrunk-toward-uniform version of the truth. The obvious consequence is regression dilution — an attenuated coefficient and a smaller apparent effect — and measuring it in this simulator says that at realistic rates it is **small**: on the 452-gene reference design, 0.5 % mis-assignment moves the hit/non-hit separation from 0.799 to 0.794 among the genes that were identifiable to begin with. Deep sequencing averages most of it away.

records.context: ``numpy.random.Generator.dirichlet`` draws independent gammas and normalises them. At small concentration the individual gamma draws underflow to exactly ``0.0``, so a gene gets an abundance of exactly zero — measured here, at ``alpha = 0.05`` with 452 categories, numpy produces exact zeros in roughly one draw in ten, and this routine produces none. A zero abundance removes the gene from every well, and the downstream read fraction for that gene becomes ``0 / 0`` in any well where nothing else amplified.

records.source: ``numpy.random.Generator.dirichlet`` draws independent gammas and normalises them. At small concentration the individual gamma draws underflow to exactly ``0.0``, so a gene gets an abundance of exactly zero — measured here, at ``alpha = 0.05`` with 452 categories, numpy produces exact zeros in roughly one draw in ten, and this routine produces none. A zero abundance removes the gene from every well, and the downstream read fraction for that gene becomes ``0 / 0`` in any well where nothing else amplified.
records.translation: ``numpy.random.Generator.dirichlet`` dregur óháðar gamma-stærðir og staðlar þær. Við lítinn styrk undirflæða einstök gamma-úrtök í nákvæmlega ``0.0``, svo gen fær magn sem er nákvæmlega núll — mælt hér, við ``alpha = 0.05`` með 452 flokkum, framleiðir numpy nákvæm núll í um það bil einu úrtaki af hverjum tíu, og þessi aðferð framleiðir engin. Magn upp á núll fjarlægir genið úr öllum brunnum, og lestrahlutfall þess gens síðar í ferlinu verður ``0 / 0`` í hverjum brunni þar sem ekkert annað magnaðist.

records.context: **Where the under-dispersed case is approximate, and which way.** A binomial has an integer number of trials, so it cannot hit an arbitrary ``(mean, var)`` pair. Given the rounded ``n``, the success probability is set to ``mean / n`` so the **mean is exact** and the realised variance is ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``, the nearest value the family attains — within about ``1/n`` relative of the request. The mean is the one preserved because it is the biologically meaningful quantity (cells per well) and it sets the scale of everything downstream, whereas a variance off by a percent changes only how wide the well-to-well spread is. Rounding ``n`` while keeping ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` — the naive inversion — biases the *mean* instead, by up to half a count, which is a systematic error in every well of a sweep.

Given the rounded ``n``, the success probability is set to ``mean / n`` so the **mean is exact** and the realised variance is ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``, the nearest value the family attains — within about ``1/n`` relative of the request. The mean is the one preserved because it is the biologically meaningful quantity (cells per well) and it sets the scale of everything downstream, whereas a variance off by a percent changes only how wide the well-to-well spread is. Rounding ``n`` while keeping ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` — the naive inversion — biases the *mean* instead, by up to half a count, which is a systematic error in every well of a sweep.
records.translation: **Hvar vandreifða tilvikið er nálgun, og í hvaða átt.** Tvíliðudreifing hefur heiltölufjölda tilrauna, svo hún getur ekki hitt handahófskennt ``(mean, var)``-par. Miðað við námundað ``n`` eru líkur á árangri settar á ``mean / n`` svo **meðaltalið er nákvæmt** og raunveruleg dreifni er ``mean * (1 - mean/n)``, næsta gildi sem fjölskyldan nær — innan um ``1/n`` hlutfallslega frá beiðninni. Meðaltalinu er haldið því það er líffræðilega marktæka stærðin (frumur á brunn) og það ákvarðar kvarða alls sem á eftir kemur, en dreifni sem skeikar um prósent breytir aðeins því hve breið dreifingin milli brunna er. Að námunda ``n`` en halda ``p = (mean - var) / mean`` — einfalda andhverfan — skekkir í staðinn *meðaltalið*, um allt að hálfa talningu, sem er kerfisbundin villa í hverjum brunni yfirferðar.

records.context: Both imaging and sequencing plates originate from *one shared source*: the spot plate. Thus the genotypes in a well are one physical fact observed twice. Each stage uses an independent random stream. Changing the imaging-cell count therefore leaves sequencing draws unchanged. This separation allows meaningful comparison across a sweep of parameter values. Otherwise each point would also contain unrelated randomization.
records.label: spacr.power_simulate.simulate_screen#1
records.review_basis: Direct AI technical authoring against exact current English source and normal target-neutral context
records.source: The imaging and sequencing plates are both simulated from the *same* spot plate — which genotypes are in a well is one physical fact, observed twice. Each stage draws from its own spawned child stream, so changing the number of imaging cells does not shift the sequencing draws; that independence is what makes a parameter sweep interpretable, since otherwise every point on the sweep would differ by an unrelated re-randomisation as well as by the parameter.
records.translation: Myndatöku- og raðgreiningarplöturnar eru báðar hermdar út frá *sömu* blettaplötunni — hvaða arfgerðir eru í brunni er ein efnisleg staðreynd, mæld tvisvar. Hvert stig dregur úr eigin afleiddum undirstraumi, svo breyting á fjölda frumna í myndatöku hliðrar ekki raðgreiningarúrtökunum; það óhæði er það sem gerir yfirferð yfir færibreytu túlkanlega, því annars myndi hver punktur í yfirferðinni vera ólíkur vegna óskyldrar endurslembunar auk færibreytunnar.
